env.PLAYER_PROMPT: Play the bank. Mine the richest cell within three steps, come home before you are the heaviest ship on the board, and never let a loaded ship end a turn next to a lighter enemy. Build a second shipyard early on the far side of your quadrant.

Play the collision rule. Keep your hulls light and hunt loaded enemy ships near their shipyards; take the cargo instead of mining it. Spawn aggressively while halite is cheap and raze an undefended enemy yard when the trade is even.
